scoreObj.top_issue: The creator pitched a PPV in the very first reply to a brand-new fan without building rapport, as seen in 'aw u think so? alright, lemme give u a peek then' immediately followed by the PPV.
scoreObj.fix_recommendation: Update the prompt to require at least 2-3 conversational exchanges building rapport and teasing playfully before any PPV pitch to new fans, even for low-cost teasers. This ensures better pacing and avoids coming across as transactional right away.
